# Vendored font assets

These files are checked into the repository so the static atlas has no runtime
dependency on Google Fonts.

- `cormorant-garamond-v21-latin.woff2`: Cormorant Garamond variable font,
  weights 300–700, Latin subset. Google Fonts version 21; SIL Open Font License.
- `libre-baskerville-v24-latin.woff2`: Libre Baskerville variable font,
  weights 400–700, Latin subset. Google Fonts version 24; SIL Open Font License.
- `material-icons-v145.woff2`: Material Icons, Google Fonts version 145;
  Apache License 2.0.
- `material-symbols-outlined-v367.woff2`: Material Symbols Outlined, Google
  Fonts version 367; Apache License 2.0.

The source URLs and version numbers are intentionally reflected in the
filenames and in `fonts.css` so upgrades remain explicit and reviewable.
